_comment: Modelica short library name -> GitHub (owner, repo), for the uses() annotation identify-modelica.py reads. A name here becomes pkg:github/<owner>/<repo>@<version>, which enrich-github-cpe.py can then attach a CPE to if the pair is also curated there. A name NOT here falls back to pkg:generic/<name>@<version> rather than guessing a repository. Extend as needed; only add a pair you have confirmed is the actual upstream of the library.
